epics.description:
Critical breakdown in Congress bills ingestion system requiring immediate attention and comprehensive solution.

**Business Impact:**
- Congress bills ingestion completely broken (0 records vs 725 working members)
- Blocking core functionality of the legislative data platform
- Preventing users from accessing congressional bill information

**Root Cause Analysis:**
- Foreign key constraint violation in chamber mapping
- Missing validation layer for data integrity
- Insufficient error handling and recovery mechanisms

**Success Criteria:**
- [ ] Chamber mapping foreign key constraint resolved
- [ ] Data validation layer implemented
- [ ] Error recovery mechanisms deployed
- [ ] Congress bills ingestion fully functional
- [ ] Comprehensive monitoring and alerting in place

**Epic Links:**
- Blocks: All Congress-related feature development
- Affects: Core platform functionality
- Related to: GitHub issues #1, #2

Complete implementation of sophisticated OpenStates ingestion framework with missing method implementations.

**Business Value:**
- Enable comprehensive state-level legislative data ingestion
- Support advanced data processing and validation
- Provide foundation for scalable state data expansion

**Implementation Scope:**
- Complete 5 missing method implementations
- Add comprehensive error handling and logging
- Implement rate limiting and parallel processing
- Add monitoring and alerting integration

**Success Criteria:**
- [ ] All 5 missing methods fully implemented
- [ ] Comprehensive error handling deployed
- [ ] Rate limiting system operational
- [ ] Parallel processing working effectively
- [ ] Full monitoring integration complete

**Epic Links:**
- Depends on: OD-1 (Congress fixes)
- Blocks: State data expansion capabilities
- Related to: GitHub issue #3

Project v2 initiative to implement full PGVector integration for semantic search capabilities across legislative documents.

**Business Vision:**
Enable users to search legislative documents based on semantic meaning rather than exact keyword matching, revolutionizing how users discover related legislation and policy documents.

**Technical Architecture:**
- PGVector extension for PostgreSQL
- Sentence-transformers for document embedding generation
- Vector similarity search algorithms
- High-performance indexing for fast search responses
- Integration with existing API endpoints

**Success Criteria:**
- [ ] PGVector extension configured and operational
- [ ] Document embedding generation pipeline deployed
- [ ] Semantic search API endpoints live
- [ ] Search result ranking algorithm implemented
- [ ] Performance optimization with proper indexing
- [ ] Comprehensive testing and validation complete

**Epic Links:**
- Foundation for: All semantic search features
- Enables: AI-powered legislative research
- Related to: GitHub issue #6, Linear epic #5

Comprehensive historical data ingestion and archival system for complete legislative history.

**Business Value:**
Provide researchers, policymakers, and citizens access to complete historical legislative data, enabling longitudinal analysis and policy trend identification.

**Implementation Scope:**
- Historical bill data spanning multiple Congress sessions
- Roll call vote data with full voting records
- Committee historical membership and activity data
- Amendment tracking across time periods
- Data migration tools for existing information

**Success Criteria:**
- [ ] Historical data sources researched and documented
- [ ] Extended database schema implemented
- [ ] Roll call vote ingestion operational
- [ ] Committee historical data integrated
- [ ] Amendment tracking system functional
- [ ] Migration tools developed and tested

**Epic Links:**
- Builds on: Existing Congress data infrastructure
- Enables: Historical research and analysis
- Related to: GitHub issue #7, Linear epic #6

stories.summary: Fix Congress Bills chamber mapping foreign key constraint
stories.description:
As a data engineer, I need to fix the foreign key constraint violation in Congress bills ingestion so that chamber data is properly mapped before insertion.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Chamber mapping data is validated before insertion
- [ ] Foreign key constraint violations are prevented
- [ ] Error messages clearly indicate missing chamber data
- [ ] Data validation logging is comprehensive
- [ ] Tests cover all chamber mapping scenarios

**Technical Details:**
- File: scripts/ingest_congress_bills_incremental.py (line 123)
- Error: psycopg2.ForeignKeyViolation: INSERT INTO bills (chamber_id, ...) VALUES (NULL, ...) is not allowed
- Solution: Add pre-insertion validation and mapping layer

**Related Issues:**
- Epic: OD-1 (Congress Data Ingestion Crisis)
- GitHub: #1
- Story Points: 8

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Comprehensive error handling for invalid bill data
- [ ] Rate limiting integration for API calls
- [ ] Logging and monitoring integration
- [ ] Unit tests covering all processing scenarios
- [ ] Performance optimization for large bill datasets

**Technical Implementation:**
- File: scripts/enhanced_openstates_ingestion.py (line 819)
- Framework: Existing sophisticated ingestion framework
- Integration: Must work with existing rate limiting and monitoring

**Related Issues:**

- Story Points: 13

stories.summary: Research PGVector integration requirements and constraints
stories.description:
As an AI specialist, I need to research and document PGVector integration requirements so that the semantic search implementation can be properly planned and executed.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Complete technical requirements analysis documented
- [ ] Integration constraints and limitations identified
- [ ] Performance benchmarks and scaling considerations documented
- [ ] Security and compliance requirements analyzed
- [ ] Migration strategy for existing data defined
- [ ] Architecture recommendations with implementation roadmap

**Research Scope:**
- PGVector extension compatibility with PostgreSQL versions
- Vector similarity search algorithms and their trade-offs
- Embedding model selection criteria and performance
- Indexing strategies for optimal search performance
- Memory and storage requirements for vector data
- Integration patterns with existing API architecture

**Related Issues:**
- Epic: ODV2-1 (PGVector Semantic Search Foundation)
- GitHub: #6
- Story Points: 8
- Blocks: ODV2-202 (Vector schema design)

stories.summary: Fix monitoring system delegate registration issues
stories.description:
As a backend developer, I need to fix the delegate registration issues in the monitoring system so that progress tracking and alerting work correctly.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Delegate registration logic corrected and tested
- [ ] Delegate mismatch scenarios properly handled
- [ ] Registration logging and debugging enhanced
- [ ] Integration tests for delegate lifecycle
- [ ] Monitoring alerts for registration failures
- [ ] Documentation updated for delegate management

**Technical Details:**
- File: monitoring/delegates.py (line 45)
- Issue: Delegate mismatch in registration process
- Impact: Affects system observability and progress tracking
- Solution: Improve registration algorithm and validation

**Related Issues:**
- Epic: OD-1 (Congress Data Ingestion Crisis)
- GitHub: #3
- Story Points: 5
- Dependencies: OD-101 (Congress fixes)
